text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before her debut, Seiun Sky trains with her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This includes Special Week, with her keen final sprint, and the quietly passionate Grass Wonder…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As well as El Condor Pasa, who wants to dominate the racing world, and the first-rate elite, King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a generation bursting with natural talent, but Sky is determined not to give up the lead.
